title: Abu Dhabi Airport Freezone
content:
Business Setup in
Abu Dhabi Airport Free Zone

Setup your business in the Abu Dhabi Airport Free Zone ADAFZ in a Quick, Easy and Effective manner with Connect Middle East.

Contact Us

Schedule a Consultation Call with Our Expert

Let Our Experts help you setup business in Middle East

Schedule A Call

Benefits of Abu Dhabi Airport Freezone

For companies wishing to establish themselves in the United Arab Emirates, the Abu Dhabi Airport Free Zone (ADAFZ) is a special economic zone housed inside the Abu Dhabi International Airport.
ADAFZ offers a number of advantages as a free zone:

  • Access to all the resources your business needs in one place
  • Unlimited business opportunities
  • Modern and innovative infrastructure and world-class facilities
  • No corporate and income tax
  • Foreign investors can have 100% ownership
  • Access to regional and international markets
  • It’s easy to import and export from ADAFZ
  • Total repatriation of capital and profits
  • No custom duties
  • Abu Dhabi airport free zone regulations are investor-friendly
Contact Us

Read More

Trading License

C-uae will help you obtain trading license for your business setup in ADAFZ

Read More
Contact Us

ADAFZ Freezone

Required Documents for ADAFZ Freezone

Depending on the kind of license and the type of business, different documentation may be needed to open a business in the Abu Dhabi Airport Free Zone (ADAFZ). Nonetheless, the following are some of the typical paperwork needed for company establishment in the ADAFZ:

  • Passport copy of owners
  • Passport size photo in color with white background
  • Business plan.
  • Company Application Form (for Initial Approval and Registration).
  • Registration Certificate or Trade License (Existing company)
  • Audited financial report or bank reference
  • MOA (attested)
  • Appointment of manager and POA of manager
  • The registration process is pretty fast since it can take up to 14 working days.
  • After registering and licensing the company, it’s required to start with the Visa Process that can be obtained by the company depending on its size.

Contact Us

FAQ's

Know more about the frequently asked questions

How can I start a business in dubai?

There are few steps that you need to do before starting a business setup in Dubai. You are going to need a license Application, Attested LLC agreement, Governmental forms, name of your business reservation certificate, Initial approval certificate, Government authorities approval, lease contract, Ejari with certificate approval.

Is Dubai beneficial for Business purposes?
There is no major taxation in Dubai and due to which Dubai is a great place if you want to start your business setup in Dubai.
Best Business for me to start in dubai?
The best business in Dubai that is 100% going to benefit you in every way is the Real Estate business. This business is great to start because it is one of the industries that is mostly established in Dubai. After the real estate, you can start Financial service business, as UAE has an advanced financial system in place.
I am an Indian. Can I start a business in Dubai, UAE?
Yes of course you can start a business in Dubai, not only Indian but everyone from other countries who wants to start business in Dubai are welcome to start their business. In Dubai with the low import duty, free trade, and no taxation you can set up a business that is going to attract people towards your business.
Can I start an online business in Dubai, UAE?
Yes, you can start the online business in Dubai, UAE but first you need to know about the legal framework for your business, after that you need to pick a place where you can register the business after this you need to request the license, initial approval certificate, after you have done this you need to draft the Memorandum of association (MOA) and local service agent agreement, the next step towards your online business in Dubai is register a physical office in Dubai, after you have register you need to sign in the physical office in Dubai, UAE and you are done you have successfully started your online business.
What is an LLC company in the UAE?
LLC full form is Limited liability company and this is the common form of business that is followed by everyone here in Dubai, UAE. LLC companies can be created by a minimum of 2 shareholders and a maximum of 50 shareholders whose liability is limited to their corporate capital stock.
How can I get residency in Dubai?
You can get residency in Dubai by finding the sponsor who can sponsor you. You can also get residency by owning a property here in dubai as this is going to help you get the citizenship of Dubai. After this you can also open a bank account in Dubai and you will also find some international bank in Dubai in which you can open an account.
Can a foreigner own a business in Dubai,UAE?
Yes, foreigners can own business in Dubai and the better place to own business in Dubai is in freezone Dubai as it is going to allow the business to own 100 percent of the firm. LLC partnership in Dubai will allow you to own 49% of the business and the rest will be owned by the UAE nationalities.
How much is a business license going to cost in Dubai?
Dubai license cost is going to differ from zone to zone and type of business you want to set up in Dubai. Still the rough figure is that it will be lowest to the highest.

Do you have more questions?

Contact Us

What is the Dubai UAE VAT rate?

What is required to register for VAT in Dubai, United Arab Emirates?

When must VAT returns be submitted in Dubai, United Arab Emirates?

What does an auditor do in Dubai, United Arab Emirates?
  • In Dubai, United Arab Emirates, an auditor is in charge of independently confirming the completeness and accuracy of a company’s financial statements as well as the observance of accounting rules.
How does one go about starting a business in Dubai, United Arab Emirates?
  • In order to start a business in Dubai, United Arab Emirates, you must choose a legal structure, get the relevant licenses and permissions, and register the firm with the appropriate authorities.

Can I start an online business in Dubai, UAE?

What is an LLC company in the UAE?

Is Dubai beneficial for Business purposes?
There is no major taxation in Dubai and due to which Dubai is a great place if you want to start your business setup in Dubai.
Best Business for me to start in dubai?
The best business in Dubai that is 100% going to benefit you in every way is the Real Estate business. This business is great to start because it is one of the industries that is mostly established in Dubai. After the real estate, you can start Financial service business, as UAE has an advanced financial system in place.
I am an Indian. Can I start a business in Dubai, UAE?
Yes of course you can start a business in Dubai, not only Indian but everyone from other countries who wants to start business in Dubai are welcome to start their business. In Dubai with the low import duty, free trade, and no taxation you can set up a business that is going to attract people towards your business.
Can I start an online business in Dubai, UAE?
Yes, you can start the online business in Dubai, UAE but first you need to know about the legal framework for your business, after that you need to pick a place where you can register the business after this you need to request the license, initial approval certificate, after you have done this you need to draft the Memorandum of association (MOA) and local service agent agreement, the next step towards your online business in Dubai is register a physical office in Dubai, after you have register you need to sign in the physical office in Dubai, UAE and you are done you have successfully started your online business.
What is an LLC company in the UAE?
LLC full form is Limited liability company and this is the common form of business that is followed by everyone here in Dubai, UAE. LLC companies can be created by a minimum of 2 shareholders and a maximum of 50 shareholders whose liability is limited to their corporate capital stock.
How can I get residency in Dubai?
You can get residency in Dubai by finding the sponsor who can sponsor you. You can also get residency by owning a property here in dubai as this is going to help you get the citizenship of Dubai. After this you can also open a bank account in Dubai and you will also find some international bank in Dubai in which you can open an account.
Can a foreigner own a business in Dubai,UAE?
Yes, foreigners can own business in Dubai and the better place to own business in Dubai is in freezone Dubai as it is going to allow the business to own 100 percent of the firm. LLC partnership in Dubai will allow you to own 49% of the business and the rest will be owned by the UAE nationalities.
How much is a business license going to cost in Dubai?
Dubai license cost is going to differ from zone to zone and type of business you want to set up in Dubai. Still the rough figure is that it will be lowest to the highest.

You have a Query about PRO Service in Dubai
We are here to Guide

What are PRO services?

PRO services, also known as Public Relations Officer services, are professional services that assist businesses in handling government-related procedures, document processing, visa processing, and other administrative tasks.

Can PRO services help with document translation and notarization?

Yes, many PRO service providers offer document translation and notarization services as part of their offerings. These services can be useful when dealing with government authorities or submitting documents in a different language.

Why do businesses need PRO services?

Businesses often require PRO services to navigate the complex regulatory landscape, save time and effort in dealing with government authorities, ensure compliance with legal requirements, and streamline administrative processes.

How do PRO services expedite government-related processes?

PRO service providers have extensive knowledge and experience in dealing with government authorities and their procedures. They understand the requirements, documentation, and submission processes, which helps expedite the completion of tasks and reduces the chances of errors or delays.

What types of services do PRO service providers offer?

PRO service providers offer a range of services, including but not limited to: Document attestation and legalization. Visa and immigration services. Trade license registration and renewal. Labor contract and employment-related services. Ministry approvals and permits. Freezone and offshore company setup. Business visa sponsorship. Government entity approvals and clearances.

Are PRO services cost-effective for businesses?
PRO services can be cost-effective for businesses, especially when considering the time, effort, and resources required to handle government-related tasks internally. Outsourcing these tasks to PRO service providers can free up valuable resources and allow businesses to focus on their core operations.
How can PRO services help in business setup?

PRO services can assist in various aspects of business setup, such as obtaining necessary licenses and permits, registering with government authorities, handling visa and immigration processes, and ensuring compliance with labor and employment regulations.

Can PRO services assist with visa-related matters?
Yes, PRO services often specialize in visa and immigration-related services. They can help with visa applications, renewal, cancellation, and sponsorship, ensuring compliance with immigration regulations and making the process smoother and more efficient.
Are PRO services only required for new businesses?

PRO services are not limited to new businesses. Established businesses may also need PRO services for various purposes, including license renewals, visa renewals, amendment of company details, and ongoing compliance with government regulations.

You wanted to Learn More About PRO Services in Dubai, UAE?

FAQ's

You have a Query about PRO Service in Dubai
We are here to Guide

What are PRO services?

PRO services, also known as Public Relations Officer services, are professional services that assist businesses in handling government-related procedures, document processing, visa processing, and other administrative tasks.

Can PRO services help with document translation and notarization?

Yes, many PRO service providers offer document translation and notarization services as part of their offerings. These services can be useful when dealing with government authorities or submitting documents in a different language.

Why do businesses need PRO services?

Businesses often require PRO services to navigate the complex regulatory landscape, save time and effort in dealing with government authorities, ensure compliance with legal requirements, and streamline administrative processes.

How do PRO services expedite government-related processes?

PRO service providers have extensive knowledge and experience in dealing with government authorities and their procedures. They understand the requirements, documentation, and submission processes, which helps expedite the completion of tasks and reduces the chances of errors or delays.

What types of services do PRO service providers offer?

PRO service providers offer a range of services, including but not limited to: Document attestation and legalization. Visa and immigration services. Trade license registration and renewal. Labor contract and employment-related services. Ministry approvals and permits. Freezone and offshore company setup. Business visa sponsorship. Government entity approvals and clearances.

Are PRO services cost-effective for businesses?
PRO services can be cost-effective for businesses, especially when considering the time, effort, and resources required to handle government-related tasks internally. Outsourcing these tasks to PRO service providers can free up valuable resources and allow businesses to focus on their core operations.
How can PRO services help in business setup?

PRO services can assist in various aspects of business setup, such as obtaining necessary licenses and permits, registering with government authorities, handling visa and immigration processes, and ensuring compliance with labor and employment regulations.

Can PRO services assist with visa-related matters?
Yes, PRO services often specialize in visa and immigration-related services. They can help with visa applications, renewal, cancellation, and sponsorship, ensuring compliance with immigration regulations and making the process smoother and more efficient.
Are PRO services only required for new businesses?

PRO services are not limited to new businesses. Established businesses may also need PRO services for various purposes, including license renewals, visa renewals, amendment of company details, and ongoing compliance with government regulations.

      Чтобы начать бизнес в Дубае, сначала выберите юридическую форму — Мейнленд или Свободную зону. Затем получите необходимую лицензию и зарегистрируйте компанию в государственных органах. Мы поможем вам со всеми этапами: подготовкой документов, получением разрешений и запуском бизнеса.

    World’s lowest corporate tax

    No Travel or In-Person Visit Required

    Why C-UAE?

    Trusted by 2,000+ clients worldwide

    Personalized support from setup to scale

    Mastery in Mainland and Free Zones

    Trusted by UAE Government and leading banks

    What’s included in our Business Setup
    services?

    Business Licensing

    We help you choose the correct license category based on your activity and structure. Whether you need a professional, commercial, or industrial license, we ensure it aligns with UAE laws. This reduces the risk of rejection, delays, or extra fees from doing it wrong. You also get clarity on license costs upfront.

    Business Setup Consultation

    Many founders are unsure where to start. Should you go with a Free Zone or the Mainland? Do you need an office, or will a virtual desk work? What documents are required? We answer all of this based on your exact business type, so you avoid costly missteps and get started with confidence.

    Corporate Sponsorship

    For businesses that need local sponsorship, we provide corporate sponsors who are legally secure and contractually fair. You keep control of your business. We eliminate the fear of hidden clauses, interference, or sponsor-related complications.

    Visa and Residency Services

    Getting a visa in the UAE can involve multiple steps. From document collection to medical tests, Emirates ID, and residence stamping, we handle it all for you. Whether you need an investor visa, a partner visa, or staff visas, we make it easy, fast, and fully legal.

    HR Outsourcing

    Need to hire? We help you onboard employees with legally compliant contracts, salary processing, WPS registration, leave management, and more. Whether you have a small team or a growing workforce, we ensure everything is accurate, timely, and in line with UAE labour law.

    PRO Services

    We take the headache out of government paperwork. That includes labour approvals, immigration submissions, document clearance, legal translations, and all necessary follow-ups. You will never have to visit a government office or wait in line.

    How it works?

    Submit A Request

    Start by telling us your business goals. We’ll review your details and assign the right advisor.

    Free Consultation

    We walk you through the best setup. Mainland or Free Zone, we help you decide with clarity.

    Registration

    We prepare your documents, secure approvals, and register your business with the authorities.

    You're All Set

How can I start a business in dubai?

There are few steps that you need to do before starting a business setup in Dubai. You are going to need a license Application, Attested LLC agreement, Governmental forms, name of your business reservation certificate, Initial approval certificate, Government authorities approval, lease contract, Ejari with certificate approval.

Is Dubai beneficial for Business purposes?
There is no major taxation in Dubai and due to which Dubai is a great place if you want to start your business setup in Dubai.
Best Business for me to start in dubai?
The best business in Dubai that is 100% going to benefit you in every way is the Real Estate business. This business is great to start because it is one of the industries that is mostly established in Dubai. After the real estate, you can start Financial service business, as UAE has an advanced financial system in place.
I am an Indian. Can I start a business in Dubai, UAE?
Yes of course you can start a business in Dubai, not only Indian but everyone from other countries who wants to start business in Dubai are welcome to start their business. In Dubai with the low import duty, free trade, and no taxation you can set up a business that is going to attract people towards your business.
Can I start an online business in Dubai, UAE?
Yes, you can start the online business in Dubai, UAE but first you need to know about the legal framework for your business, after that you need to pick a place where you can register the business after this you need to request the license, initial approval certificate, after you have done this you need to draft the Memorandum of association (MOA) and local service agent agreement, the next step towards your online business in Dubai is register a physical office in Dubai, after you have register you need to sign in the physical office in Dubai, UAE and you are done you have successfully started your online business.
What is an LLC company in the UAE?
LLC full form is Limited liability company and this is the common form of business that is followed by everyone here in Dubai, UAE. LLC companies can be created by a minimum of 2 shareholders and a maximum of 50 shareholders whose liability is limited to their corporate capital stock.
How can I get residency in Dubai?
You can get residency in Dubai by finding the sponsor who can sponsor you. You can also get residency by owning a property here in dubai as this is going to help you get the citizenship of Dubai. After this you can also open a bank account in Dubai and you will also find some international bank in Dubai in which you can open an account.
Can a foreigner own a business in Dubai,UAE?
Yes, foreigners can own business in Dubai and the better place to own business in Dubai is in freezone Dubai as it is going to allow the business to own 100 percent of the firm. LLC partnership in Dubai will allow you to own 49% of the business and the rest will be owned by the UAE nationalities.
How much is a business license going to cost in Dubai?
Dubai license cost is going to differ from zone to zone and type of business you want to set up in Dubai. Still the rough figure is that it will be lowest to the highest.

Do you have more questions?

Contact Us

What is Tecom Freezone?
In Dubai, United Arab Emirates, there is a business hub called Tecom Freezone. It is one of Dubai’s biggest and most thriving free zones, providing entrepreneurs and enterprises with a variety of business-friendly rules, incentives, and infrastructure.
How long does it take to set up a business in Tecom Freezone?
Depending on the type of business and the level of application completion, the timeframe for establishing a business in Tecom Freezone may change. Nonetheless, it usually takes two to four weeks to complete the process.
What are the benefits of setting up a business in Tecom Freezone?
100% foreign ownership, tax exemption, faster company registration, access to cutting-edge infrastructure and facilities, and quick visa processing for staff are just a few advantages of establishing a firm in Tecom Freezone.
What are the costs associated with setting up a business in Tecom Freezone?
What types of businesses can be set up in Tecom Freezone?
Tecom Freezone caters to a wide range of business sectors, including media, information technology, education, healthcare, and more.
Do I need to have a physical office in Tecom Freezone to set up a business?
Absolutely, having a physical office or workspace inside the free zone is one of the conditions for establishing a firm in Tecom Freezone.
What is the process for setting up a business in Tecom Freezone?
A business must submit a business plan, choose a legal entity, apply for a trade license, and register with the Dubai Chamber of Business and Industry in order to establish a company in Tecom Freezone.
Can I operate my business outside of Tecom Freezone if I set it up there?
Yes, businesses set up in Tecom Freezone are allowed to operate outside of the free zone, as long as they comply with the regulations and requirements of the Dubai authorities.
What are the requirements for setting up a business in Tecom Freezone?
Depending on the type of business, different requirements may apply for establishing one in Tecom Freezone, although most frequently a valid passport, proof of address, financial records, and other pertinent documents are needed.
Is it mandatory to have a local sponsor to set up a business in Tecom Freezone?
No, one advantage of establishing a firm in Tecom Freezone is that there is no requirement for a local sponsor and 100% international ownership is permitted.

FAQ's

Know more about the frequently asked questions

Can you own 100% of a company in Saudi Arabia as a foreign investor?

You can own 100% of your company in Saudi Arabia in many sectors. The Saudi government allows you full foreign ownership under its Ministry of Investment. You do not need a local sponsor for most commercial and professional activities.

What is the most common business structure for foreign investors in Saudi Arabia?

LLC, or Limited Liability Company is the fast and most practical option for market entry. It is also the most popular structure among foreign investors due to the amount of flexibility, protection for your personal assets, and full foreign ownership it offers.

You can form an LLC with one or more shareholders for business activities such as trading, consulting, technology, and service businesses.

How long does it take to set up a company in Saudi Arabia?

Company formation in Saudi Arabia will take you between 4 to 12 weeks, depending on your business activity, approvals, and documentation. The process includes investment licensing, commercial registration, tax registration, and opening a corporate bank account. With expert guidance, you can avoid delays and complete the setup even more quickly and efficiently.

What documents do you need to register a company in Saudi Arabia?

You will need passport copies of your shareholders and directors, your business plan, proof of address, and company incorporation documents if a foreign parent company is involved. For registering your company in KSA, you also need your Commercial Registration (CR), Memorandum of Association (MoA), and Articles of Association (AoA) attested by MoFA and the Saudi Embassy. Moreover, you might need additional approvals depending on your business activity.

What licenses are required to start a business in Saudi Arabia?

For starting your business in Saudi Arabia, you need an investment license from the Ministry of Investment, followed by commercial registration from the Ministry of Commerce. You must also register with the tax authority, Chamber of Commerce, and labor authorities. Depending on your business activity, you may also need additional municipal or industry-specific licenses.

What are the main benefits of setting up a company in Saudi Arabia?

Saudi Arabia offers you access to the largest economy in the Middle East, strong government support for foreign investors, and a fast growing private sector. You benefit from strategic access to regional markets, infrastructure investment under Vision 2030, and expanding opportunities in technology, tourism, logistics, and professional services. This makes Saudi Arabia an ideal location for your business’ long term growth.

Do you need to be physically present in Saudi Arabia to register a company?

You do not always need to be physically present for every step but certain processes such as bank account opening or signing legal documents may require your presence or a legal representative.

Working with us as your business setup consultant helps you manage most procedures remotely and reduces travel requirements.

Can you open a corporate bank account after company formation in Saudi Arabia?

Yes, once your company is registered and licensed, you can open a corporate bank account in Saudi Arabia. Banks will require your commercial registration, license, shareholder documents, and compliance verification.

With a corporate bank account, you can operate legally, receive payments, and conduct your business transactions both locally and internationally.

Do you have more questions?

How can I start a business in dubai?

Is Dubai beneficial for Business purposes?
There is no major taxation in Dubai and due to which Dubai is a great place if you want to start your business setup in Dubai.
Best Business for me to start in dubai?
The best business in Dubai that is 100% going to benefit you in every way is the Real Estate business. This business is great to start because it is one of the industries that is mostly established in Dubai. After the real estate, you can start Financial service business, as UAE has an advanced financial system in place.
I am an Indian. Can I start a business in Dubai, UAE?
Yes of course you can start a business in Dubai, not only Indian but everyone from other countries who wants to start business in Dubai are welcome to start their business. In Dubai with the low import duty, free trade, and no taxation you can set up a business that is going to attract people towards your business.
Can I start an online business in Dubai, UAE?
Yes, you can start the online business in Dubai, UAE but first you need to know about the legal framework for your business, after that you need to pick a place where you can register the business after this you need to request the license, initial approval certificate, after you have done this you need to draft the Memorandum of association (MOA) and local service agent agreement, the next step towards your online business in Dubai is register a physical office in Dubai, after you have register you need to sign in the physical office in Dubai, UAE and you are done you have successfully started your online business.
What is an LLC company in the UAE?
LLC full form is Limited liability company and this is the common form of business that is followed by everyone here in Dubai, UAE. LLC companies can be created by a minimum of 2 shareholders and a maximum of 50 shareholders whose liability is limited to their corporate capital stock.
How can I get residency in Dubai?
You can get residency in Dubai by finding the sponsor who can sponsor you. You can also get residency by owning a property here in dubai as this is going to help you get the citizenship of Dubai. After this you can also open a bank account in Dubai and you will also find some international bank in Dubai in which you can open an account.
Can a foreigner own a business in Dubai,UAE?
Yes, foreigners can own business in Dubai and the better place to own business in Dubai is in freezone Dubai as it is going to allow the business to own 100 percent of the firm. LLC partnership in Dubai will allow you to own 49% of the business and the rest will be owned by the UAE nationalities.
How much is a business license going to cost in Dubai?
Dubai license cost is going to differ from zone to zone and type of business you want to set up in Dubai. Still the rough figure is that it will be lowest to the highest.

We are here to guide you about the Business Setup in Mainland

What is a UAE Mainland business setup?

UAE Mainland company formation refers to the process of establishing and operating a business in the mainland area of the United Arab Emirates, outside of designated free zones. Mainland companies enoy the advantage of being able to operate throughout the UAE market and participate in both local and international trade.

What is the process of obtaining a trade license in the UAE Mainland?

Obtaining a trade license in UAE Mainland typically involves several key steps. First, select a business activity and determine the appropriate legal form for your company. Next, choose and reserve a trade name that complies with the Department of Economic Development (DED) requirements and obtain initial approval. Following this, prepare the necessary documents, including the Memorandum of Association (MOA) and other legal agreements. Secure a physical office space that meets DED regulations. Finally, submit all required documents to the DED to obtain your trade license. By following these steps, you can ensure a smooth and efficient process for securing your trade license in the UAE Mainland.

What are the advantages of setting up a business in the UAE Mainland?

Some advantages of business setup in the UAE Mainland include access to a larger customer base, encompassing both the local UAE market and government entities. Businesses face no restrictions on operating within the UAE or globally, providing immense flexibility. There is also the opportunity to bid on government projects and tenders. Additionally, businesses can rent office space in any location and choose from a wide range of permitted business activities, enhancing operational versatility and growth potential.

Are there any specific restrictions or regulations for certain business activities in the UAE Mainland?

Yes, certain business activities may have specific restrictions or regulations imposed by the authorities. These regulations can vary based on the nature of the activity, licensing requirements, and government policies. It is advisable to consult with relevant authorities or a professional business setup service provider for specific information.

What are the legal requirements for a business setup in UAE Mainland?

The legal requirements for UAE Mainland company formation may vary depending on the business activity and the jurisdiction.  However, common requirements include obtaining initial approval from the Department of Economic Development (DED), renting physical office space in accordance with DED guidelines, drafting a Memorandum of Association (MOA) and having it notarized, and submitting all required documents to obtain the necessary licenses.

What are the visa requirements for business owners and employees in the UAE Mainland?

The visa requirements for business owners and employees in the UAE Mainland include obtaining a residency visa, work permit, and Emirates ID. The exact requirements may vary depending on the business activity, company structure, and the nationality of the individuals involved.

Can a foreigner own a business in the UAE Mainland?

Yes, a foreigner can own a mainland company in the UAE. However, for certain business activities, a UAE national or a local service agent may be required as a sponsor or a partner. The percentage of ownership for the foreigner can vary depending on the activity and jurisdiction.

What are the taxation policies for a businesses operating in the UAE Mainland?

UAE Mainland businesses are subject to corporate tax, but the current rate is zero percent. However, there may be other taxes, such as Value Added Tax (VAT), which is applicable at a standard rate of 5% on eligible goods and services.

What are the different types of business entities in the UAE Mainland?

The common types of business entities in the UAE Mainland include Limited Liability Companies (LLC), Sole Proprietorships, Civil Companies, Branches of Foreign Companies, and Representative Offices.

How long does it take to complete the business setup process in the UAE Mainland?

The minimum time to complete the business setup process in the UAE Mainland is five days, but depending on what type of business you want to open and several other factors, this time period could be longer. Hiring local experts is the best way to get this done quickly, efficiently, and with legal compliance.

We are here to guide you about the Business Setup in Offshore

What is UAE Offshore?

UAE Offshore refers to the establishment of a company in a designated offshore jurisdiction within the United Arab Emirates. It offers various benefits such as tax exemptions, asset protection, and privacy.

What are the legal requirements for setting up an offshore company in the UAE?

The legal requirements for setting up an offshore company in the UAE may vary depending on the specific offshore jurisdiction chosen. However, common requirements include: Selecting the appropriate offshore jurisdiction. Providing the necessary documentation, such as passport copies, proof of address, and shareholder details. Appointing a registered agent or a corporate service provider. Paying the relevant incorporation fees.

What are the advantages of setting up an offshore company in the UAE?

Some advantages of setting up an offshore company in the UAE include: Tax advantages: Offshore companies enjoy tax exemptions on income, capital gains, and dividends. Asset protection: Assets held by an offshore company are protected from potential lawsuits or creditors. Privacy and confidentiality: Offshore jurisdictions offer high levels of privacy and confidentiality for company owners. Ease of incorporation: Setting up an offshore company in the UAE is a relatively straightforward process with minimal requirements.

Can an offshore company own real estate in the UAE?

Offshore companies can own real estate properties in designated freehold areas within the UAE. However, there may be certain restrictions and regulations imposed by each emirate.

Can an offshore company conduct business within the UAE?

No, offshore companies are not allowed to conduct business activities within the UAE. They are primarily established for holding assets, investments, or conducting international trade outside of the UAE.

Are there any reporting or auditing requirements for offshore companies?
Offshore companies are generally not required to submit audited financial statements or annual reports. However, it is advisable to maintain proper financial records and comply with the regulations of the chosen offshore jurisdiction.
Are there any residency requirements for offshore company owners?

Offshore company owners are not required to obtain residency in the UAE. However, they can apply for residency visas if they wish to reside in the UAE.

Can an offshore company benefit from UAE double tax treaties?

Offshore companies are not eligible for the benefits of UAE double tax treaties. These treaties apply to onshore companies that conduct business activities within the UAE.

Can an offshore company open a bank account in the UAE?

Yes, offshore companies can open bank accounts in the UAE. They can choose from a wide range of local and international banks that offer offshore banking services.

Can an offshore company be converted into an onshore company in the UAE?
Yes, it is possible to convert an offshore company into an onshore company in the UAE. The process and requirements for conversion may vary depending on the specific circumstances and the chosen onshore jurisdiction.

FAQ's

We are here to guide you about the Business Setup in Offshore

What is UAE Offshore?

UAE Offshore refers to the establishment of a company in a designated offshore jurisdiction within the United Arab Emirates. It offers various benefits such as tax exemptions, asset protection, and privacy.

What are the legal requirements for setting up an offshore company in the UAE?

The legal requirements for setting up an offshore company in the UAE may vary depending on the specific offshore jurisdiction chosen. However, common requirements include: Selecting the appropriate offshore jurisdiction. Providing the necessary documentation, such as passport copies, proof of address, and shareholder details. Appointing a registered agent or a corporate service provider. Paying the relevant incorporation fees.

What are the advantages of setting up an offshore company in the UAE?

Some advantages of setting up an offshore company in the UAE include: Tax advantages: Offshore companies enjoy tax exemptions on income, capital gains, and dividends. Asset protection: Assets held by an offshore company are protected from potential lawsuits or creditors. Privacy and confidentiality: Offshore jurisdictions offer high levels of privacy and confidentiality for company owners. Ease of incorporation: Setting up an offshore company in the UAE is a relatively straightforward process with minimal requirements.

Can an offshore company own real estate in the UAE?

Offshore companies can own real estate properties in designated freehold areas within the UAE. However, there may be certain restrictions and regulations imposed by each emirate.

Can an offshore company conduct business within the UAE?

No, offshore companies are not allowed to conduct business activities within the UAE. They are primarily established for holding assets, investments, or conducting international trade outside of the UAE.

Are there any reporting or auditing requirements for offshore companies?
Offshore companies are generally not required to submit audited financial statements or annual reports. However, it is advisable to maintain proper financial records and comply with the regulations of the chosen offshore jurisdiction.
Are there any residency requirements for offshore company owners?

Offshore company owners are not required to obtain residency in the UAE. However, they can apply for residency visas if they wish to reside in the UAE.

Can an offshore company benefit from UAE double tax treaties?

Offshore companies are not eligible for the benefits of UAE double tax treaties. These treaties apply to onshore companies that conduct business activities within the UAE.

Can an offshore company open a bank account in the UAE?

Yes, offshore companies can open bank accounts in the UAE. They can choose from a wide range of local and international banks that offer offshore banking services.

Can an offshore company be converted into an onshore company in the UAE?
Yes, it is possible to convert an offshore company into an onshore company in the UAE. The process and requirements for conversion may vary depending on the specific circumstances and the chosen onshore jurisdiction.

How can I start a business in dubai?

There are few steps that you need to do before starting a business setup in Dubai. You are going to need a license Application, Attested LLC agreement, Governmental forms, name of your business reservation certificate, Initial approval certificate, Government authorities approval, lease contract, Ejari with certificate approval.

Is Dubai beneficial for Business purposes?
There is no major taxation in Dubai and due to which Dubai is a great place if you want to start your business setup in Dubai.
Best Business for me to start in dubai?

After the real estate, you can start Financial service business, as UAE has an advanced financial system in place.
I am an Indian. Can I start a business in Dubai, UAE?
Yes of course you can start a business in Dubai, not only Indian but everyone from other countries who wants to start business in Dubai are welcome to start their business. In Dubai with the low import duty, free trade, and no taxation you can set up a business that is going to attract people towards your business.
Can I start an online business in Dubai, UAE?
Yes, you can start the online business in Dubai, UAE but first you need to know about the legal framework for your business, after that you need to pick a place where you can register the business after this you need to request the license, initial approval certificate, after you have done this you need to draft the Memorandum of association (MOA) and local service agent agreement, the next step towards your online business in Dubai is register a physical office in Dubai, after you have register you need to sign in the physical office in Dubai, UAE and you are done you have successfully started your online business.
What is an LLC company in the UAE?
LLC full form is Limited liability company and this is the common form of business that is followed by everyone here in Dubai, UAE. LLC companies can be created by a minimum of 2 shareholders and a maximum of 50 shareholders whose liability is limited to their corporate capital stock.
How can I get residency in Dubai?
You can get residency in Dubai by finding the sponsor who can sponsor you. You can also get residency by owning a property here in dubai as this is going to help you get the citizenship of Dubai. After this you can also open a bank account in Dubai and you will also find some international bank in Dubai in which you can open an account.
Can a foreigner own a business in Dubai,UAE?
Yes, foreigners can own business in Dubai and the better place to own business in Dubai is in freezone Dubai as it is going to allow the business to own 100 percent of the firm. LLC partnership in Dubai will allow you to own 49% of the business and the rest will be owned by the UAE nationalities.
How much is a business license going to cost in Dubai?
Dubai license cost is going to differ from zone to zone and type of business you want to set up in Dubai. Still the rough figure is that it will be lowest to the highest.

What is a business trade license?

A business trade license is a legal document that permits individuals or companies to engage in specific commercial activities within a defined jurisdiction. It is a requirement for conducting business operations and ensures compliance with local regulations.

Can I transfer or renew my business trade license?

Yes, in most cases, business trade licenses can be transferred or renewed. The specific procedures and requirements for transfers and renewals may vary based on local regulations and the type of business activity. It is important to follow the guidelines provided by the licensing authority and ensure timely renewal to avoid any disruptions in business operations.

Why do I need a business trade license?

A business trade license is essential for several reasons: Legitimacy: It establishes the legal existence of your business and ensures that you operate within the framework of the law. Permits and permissions: Certain activities and industries require specific permits and licenses, which are facilitated through the business trade license. Credibility: Holding a valid trade license enhances your business’s credibility and reputation among clients, suppliers, and stakeholders. Legal protection: A trade license provides legal protection and helps resolve any disputes that may arise during business operations.

Can I operate multiple businesses under one trade license?
The permissibility of operating multiple businesses under one trade license depends on the jurisdiction and local regulations. Some jurisdictions allow for multiple activities or branches to be covered by a single license, while others may require separate licenses for each business activity. It is advisable to check with the relevant licensing authority for clarity on this matter.
How do I obtain a business trade license?

The process of obtaining a business trade license may vary depending on the jurisdiction and type of business activity. Typically, it involves the following steps: Determine the type of business activity you wish to engage in. Research the specific requirements, regulations, and permits associated with your chosen activity. Prepare the necessary documentation, such as application forms, identification, business plans, and financial statements. Submit your application along with the required documents to the relevant government authority or licensing department. Pay the applicable fees and undergo any necessary inspections or evaluations. Once approved, you will receive your business trade license.

Can I apply for a trade license as a foreigner or expatriate?

Many jurisdictions allow foreigners and expatriates to apply for business trade licenses, either as individuals or through company formations. However, specific requirements, restrictions, and regulations may apply to foreign individuals or entities. It is recommended to consult with local authorities or seek legal advice to understand the specific rules and procedures for foreign business owners.

Can I operate without a business trade license?

No, it is illegal to operate a business without a valid trade license in most jurisdictions. Operating without a license can result in penalties, fines, legal issues, and potential closure of your business. It is essential to ensure compliance with local laws and obtain the necessary licenses and permits.

What are the ongoing obligations after obtaining a trade license?

After obtaining a business trade license, you will have ongoing obligations to ensure compliance with local regulations. These may include: Renewing the license within the designated timeframe. Complying with tax and financial reporting requirements. Adhering to labor laws and employment regulations. Maintaining accurate records and filing necessary documentation. Adapting to any changes in regulations or licensing requirements.

How long does it take to obtain a business trade license?

The time required to obtain a business trade license can vary depending on the jurisdiction, the complexity of the business activity, and the efficiency of the licensing process. It can range from a few weeks to several months. It is advisable to start the application process well in advance to allow for any potential delays.

Can I operate a business with a trade license issued in another jurisdiction?
Generally, a trade license issued in one jurisdiction is valid only within that specific jurisdiction. If you wish to operate a business in a different jurisdiction, you would typically need to obtain a trade license specific to that location. There may be exceptions or special arrangements in certain cases, but it is advisable to consult with the relevant authorities or seek legal advice for accurate information.

What is a commercial license?

A commercial license is a legal document issued by the relevant government authority that permits a business entity to operate and conduct commercial activities within a specific jurisdiction.

Can I operate multiple businesses under a single commercial license?
In some cases, it is possible to operate multiple businesses under a single commercial license. However, this may depend on the regulations and guidelines set by the relevant government authority.
How do I obtain a commercial license?

To obtain a commercial license, you typically need to fulfill certain requirements set by the respective government authority. These requirements may include submitting necessary documents, meeting specific criteria related to business activities, and paying the required fees.

Do I need to renew my commercial license?

Yes, commercial licenses typically require renewal on a periodic basis, which can range from one to several years depending on the jurisdiction. Failure to renew the license may result in penalties or the suspension of business operations.

What are the different types of commercial licenses available?

The types of commercial licenses vary based on the nature of the business activities. Common types include general trading licenses, professional licenses, industrial licenses, and tourism licenses.

Are there any restrictions or limitations on commercial activities?

Certain business activities may be subject to specific regulations, restrictions, or licensing requirements. It is important to research and understand the legal framework governing your desired business activities to ensure compliance.

Can a foreign individual or company obtain a commercial license?

Yes, foreign individuals and companies can apply for and obtain a commercial license in many jurisdictions. However, specific regulations and restrictions may apply depending on the country and the nature of the business.

Can I transfer or sell my commercial license?

In some cases, it is possible to transfer or sell a commercial license to another individual or company. However, this process may involve specific procedures and approvals from the relevant government authority.

How long does it take to obtain a commercial license?

The duration to obtain a commercial license can vary depending on the jurisdiction and the complexity of the business activities. It may take a few weeks to several months to complete the entire process.

Do I need a physical office or premises to obtain a commercial license?

The requirement for a physical office or premises may vary depending on the jurisdiction and the nature of the business. Some jurisdictions may require a registered office address, while others may allow virtual offices or co-working spaces.

What are PRO services?

PRO services, also known as Public Relations Officer services, are professional services that assist businesses in handling government-related procedures, document processing, visa processing, and other administrative tasks.

Can PRO services help with document translation and notarization?

Yes, many PRO service providers offer document translation and notarization services as part of their offerings. These services can be useful when dealing with government authorities or submitting documents in a different language.

Why do businesses need PRO services?

Businesses often require PRO services to navigate the complex regulatory landscape, save time and effort in dealing with government authorities, ensure compliance with legal requirements, and streamline administrative processes.

How do PRO services expedite government-related processes?

PRO service providers have extensive knowledge and experience in dealing with government authorities and their procedures. They understand the requirements, documentation, and submission processes, which helps expedite the completion of tasks and reduces the chances of errors or delays.

What types of services do PRO service providers offer?

PRO service providers offer a range of services, including but not limited to: Document attestation and legalization. Visa and immigration services. Trade license registration and renewal. Are PRO services cost-effective for businesses?
PRO services can be cost-effective for businesses, especially when considering the time, effort, and resources required to handle government-related tasks internally. Outsourcing these tasks to PRO service providers can free up valuable resources and allow businesses to focus on their core operations.
How can PRO services help in business setup?

PRO services can assist in various aspects of business setup, such as obtaining necessary licenses and permits, registering with government authorities, handling visa and immigration processes, and ensuring compliance with labor and employment regulations.

Can PRO services assist with visa-related matters?
Yes, PRO services often specialize in visa and immigration-related services. They can help with visa applications, renewal, cancellation, and sponsorship, ensuring compliance with immigration regulations and making the process smoother and more efficient.
Are PRO services only required for new businesses?

PRO services are not limited to new businesses. Established businesses may also need PRO services for various purposes, including license renewals, visa renewals, amendment of company details, and ongoing compliance with government regulations.

FAQ's

You have a Query about HR Outsourcing in Dubai
We are here to Guide

What is HR outsourcing?

HR outsourcing is the practice of hiring external HR service providers to handle various HR functions and responsibilities on behalf of a company. It involves delegating tasks such as recruitment, payroll processing, employee benefits administration, training and development, and HR compliance to an external partner.

Can HR outsourcing help with employee training and development?

Yes, many HR outsourcing providers offer training and development services. They can design and deliver customized training programs to enhance employee skills, foster professional growth, and align training initiatives with the organization’s goals.

Why do businesses opt for HR outsourcing?

Businesses choose HR outsourcing for several reasons, including: Cost savings: Outsourcing HR functions can be more cost-effective compared to maintaining an in-house HR department. Expertise and efficiency: HR outsourcing providers specialize in HR services, bringing expertise and efficiency to HR processes. Focus on core business: Outsourcing HR allows businesses to focus on their core operations and strategic initiatives. Scalability: Outsourcing offers flexibility and scalability to adapt to changing HR needs as a business grows or downsizes. Compliance and risk management: HR outsourcing providers help ensure compliance with labor laws and regulations, reducing potential risks.

Is HR outsourcing a long-term commitment?

The duration of HR outsourcing engagement can vary based on business needs and agreements with the outsourcing provider. It can be a long-term partnership or a project-based arrangement, depending on the scope of services required.

What HR functions can be outsourced?

Various HR functions can be outsourced, including but not limited to: Recruitment and staffing Employee onboarding and offboarding Payroll processing Benefits administration HR policies and procedures Performance management Training and development HR compliance and legal matters

How to choose the right HR outsourcing provider?

When selecting an HR outsourcing provider, consider factors such as their experience, industry expertise, range of services, reputation, client references, and technology capabilities. It’s also essential to have clear communication and ensure alignment with the business’s values and objectives.

Is HR outsourcing suitable for small businesses?

Yes, HR outsourcing can be beneficial for small businesses that may not have the resources or expertise to handle HR functions effectively. Outsourcing allows small businesses to access professional HR services and focus on growth without the burden of managing HR internally.

Is HR outsourcing suitable for all industries?

Yes, HR outsourcing can be beneficial for businesses across industries, including retail, hospitality, healthcare, IT, finance, and more. The specific HR needs may vary, but the core advantages of outsourcing HR functions remain relevant across different sectors.

How can HR outsourcing improve compliance?

HR outsourcing providers stay updated with the latest labor laws, regulations, and compliance requirements. We help businesses navigate complex HR regulations, maintain proper employee records, and ensure adherence to labor standards, reducing the risk of compliance issues and penalties.

What are the cost considerations for HR outsourcing?

The cost of HR outsourcing can vary based on factors such as the scope of services, the number of employees, and the complexity of HR processes. It is important to evaluate the pricing structure, service levels, and potential additional fees before finalizing an agreement with an HR outsourcing provider.

What are PRO services?

PRO services, also known as Public Relations Officer services, are professional services that assist businesses in handling government-related procedures, document processing, visa processing, and other administrative tasks.

Can PRO services help with document translation and notarization?

Yes, many PRO service providers offer document translation and notarization services as part of their offerings. These services can be useful when dealing with government authorities or submitting documents in a different language.

Why do businesses need PRO services?

Businesses often require PRO services to navigate the complex regulatory landscape, save time and effort in dealing with government authorities, ensure compliance with legal requirements, and streamline administrative processes.

How do PRO services expedite government-related processes?

PRO service providers have extensive knowledge and experience in dealing with government authorities and their procedures. They understand the requirements, documentation, and submission processes, which helps expedite the completion of tasks and reduces the chances of errors or delays.

What types of services do PRO service providers offer?

PRO service providers offer a range of services, including but not limited to: Document attestation and legalization. Visa and immigration services. Trade license registration and renewal. Labor contract and employment-related services. Ministry approvals and permits. Freezone and offshore company setup. Business visa sponsorship. Government entity approvals and clearances.

Are PRO services cost-effective for businesses?
PRO services can be cost-effective for businesses, especially when considering the time, effort, and resources required to handle government-related tasks internally. Outsourcing these tasks to PRO service providers can free up valuable resources and allow businesses to focus on their core operations.
How can PRO services help in business setup?

PRO services can assist in various aspects of business setup, such as obtaining necessary licenses and permits, registering with government authorities, handling visa and immigration processes, and ensuring compliance with labor and employment regulations.

Can PRO services assist with visa-related matters?
Yes, PRO services often specialize in visa and immigration-related services. They can help with visa applications, renewal, cancellation, and sponsorship, ensuring compliance with immigration regulations and making the process smoother and more efficient.
Are PRO services only required for new businesses?

PRO services are not limited to new businesses. Established businesses may also need PRO services for various purposes, including license renewals, visa renewals, amendment of company details, and ongoing compliance with government regulations.

What is DIFC Freezone?

The Dubai International Financial Centre (DIFC) is a leading financial hub in the Middle East, Africa, and South Asia region.

It offers a wide range of business activities, including banking, finance, insurance, consultancy, and more.

What are the benefits of DIFC free zone business setup?

There are several benefits to setting up a business in the DIFC free zone, including 100% foreign ownership, zero corporate or personal tax, and access to a highly skilled workforce.

Additionally, the DIFC provides a world-class infrastructure and regulatory framework that promotes ease of doing business.

What types of companies can be formed in the DIFC Free Zone?

The DIFC Free Zone allows for the formation of several types of companies, including limited liability companies (LLCs), branch offices, and representative offices.

These entities can engage in various business activities, such as trading, professional services, and consultancy.

Are there any limitations on business types in DIFC Freezone?

The DIFC Freezone supports a variety of business activities across multiple sectors. However, some activities may require additional approvals or specific conditions to be met.

What types of licenses are provided in DIFC Freezone?

The DIFC Freezone offers different types of licenses depending on the business activity. These include commercial licenses, service licenses, and industrial licenses.

Each license has its own set of regulations and requirements that businesses must comply with.

Can I have a physical office in DIFC Freezone?

Yes, businesses can rent office space in DIFC free zone to establish a physical presence for their company.

The DIFC offers a range of modern and state-of-the-art office spaces to accommodate businesses of all sizes.

What is the process for DIFC free zone company setup?

To establish a company in DIFC Freezone, businesses must complete several steps: submit the required documents, obtain necessary approvals, choose a license type, lease office, and finalize the registration process.

At C-UAE, we provide professional business setup services in Dubai Mainland, tailored to meet your specific goals.

Whether you’re looking to form an LLC, open an overseas branch, or set up a representative office, our expertise and knowledge of local regulations ensure a seamless experience.

With over six years of experience, we’ve assisted numerous entrepreneurs and business owners in starting their mainland companies in Dubai. From understanding tax codes and regulations to helping you source the right talent, we provide end-to-end support to make the process easy and efficient.

FAQ's

Frequently asked questions from our customers

How can I start a business in Dubai's Mainland?

You need to take numerous steps before setting up a business in the Dubai mainland districts.

You will have to get a license application, attested LLC agreement, a business name for your business reservation certificate, initial approval certificate, government authorities’ approval, a lease contract, and Ejari registration with a certificate approval.

To simplify this process, schedule a call with C-UAE’s mainland business setup consultants in Dubai, and we’ll do the heavy lifting for you and your business.

We also offer advice on business setup in Abu Dhabi mainland districts and other emirates.

Is Dubai's mainland beneficial for business purposes?

In a word: Yes. Dubai and its mainland is part of the UAE, which is one of the fastest growing markets in the world.

It’s situated between Europe, Asia, and Africa, making these markets easy to access simultainiously. Taxes for businesses in the Dubai mainland are very business oriented as well.

What is the best business to start in the Dubai mainland?

The best market for new businesses in Dubai right now is real estate.

Dubai is a rapidly developing city and region, with thousands immegrating every year to live, start businesses, seek entertainment, and all of them need housing and space.

After real estate, financial service businesses are also quite lucrative, as UAE has become a major financial hub in the region.

I am an Indian. Can I start a business in Dubai's mainland?

Yes you can start a business in the Dubai mainland. Everyone who wants to start business in Dubai is welcome to do so if they have the proper documents and approvals.

As part of our mainland business setup services in Dubai, C-UAE can help you understand which documents and approvals you need for your specific business and facilitate the process of procuring them.

Can I start an online business in the Dubai mainland?

Yes, you can start the online business in the Dubai mainland, but first you need to document and report the legal framework for your business.

You will also need to pick a place where you can register the business and get the proper business licensure and initial approval certificate.

Finally, you will need to draft a Memorandum of Association (MOA) and local service agent agreement, register a physical office in Dubai, and sign in the physical office to the appropriate Dubai authorities.

C-UAE is experienced in helping eCommerce entreprenuers get started in this exciting market.

What is an LLC company in the Dubai mainland?

LLCs, or limited liability Companies, are a common form of business in Dubai’s mainland.

LLC companies can be created by between 2 and 50 shareholders whose liability is limited to their corporate capital stock.

LLCs are popular with new business owners because of the limited liability they present and the ease of business setup. They can also be expanded into larger company structures like corporations.

Can a foreigner own a business in the Dubai mainland?

Yes, foreigners can own businesses in mainland Dubai, but there are some caveats. Foreigners should strongly consider establishing their business in a Dubai freezone as it allows for 100 percent ownership of the firm.

Other businesses in the Dubai mainland may only allow for 49% ownership of the business with the remaining 51% owned by a UAE nationals who sponsor your business.

However, recent amendments to the UAE Commercial Companies Law have made it possible for foreign investors to own more than 49% of Dubai-based companies.

How much is a business license going to cost in the Dubai mainland?

Business licenses in the Dubai mainland can vary in price depending on the type of business, company size, location, and which approvals and permits are needed.

You can expect prices in the range of AED 15,000 to AED 50,000 for a business license in the Dubai mainland.

What is a mainland business visa in Dubai?

A Mainland Business Visa in Dubai allows foreign nationals to work and conduct business in the mainland of Dubai, which is the area outside of the free zones.

This visa is typically linked to a business license issued by the Department of Economic Development (DED) in Dubai and is usually obtained by companies that are registered and operate in the mainland.

What is a mainland business in Dubai?

A mainland business in Dubai refers to a company that is registered and operates within the main areas of Dubai, outside of the designated free zones.

These businesses are licensed by the Dubai Department of Economic Development (DED) and are allowed to operate throughout the UAE without any geographical restrictions.

C-UAE can handle the mainland company registration & renewal in Dubai, UAE, so you can focus on running your business instead.

How much does it cost to set up a mainland business in Dubai?

The cost to set up a mainland business in Dubai can vary widely depending on several factors, including the nature of the business, the size of the company, the type of license required, office space requirements, and other operational needs.

A general estimate for setting up a mainland business in Dubai typically ranges from AED 15,000 to AED 50,000 or more, but C-UAE can help you get the lowest possible price for the kind of business you want to establish.

Do you have more questions?

mainEntity.name: Can a foreigner own a business in the Dubai mainland?

Know more about the frequently asked questions

What is Tecom Freezone?
In Dubai, United Arab Emirates, there is a business hub called Tecom Freezone. It is one of Dubai’s biggest and most thriving free zones, providing entrepreneurs and enterprises with a variety of business-friendly rules, incentives, and infrastructure.
How long does it take to set up a business in Tecom Freezone?
Depending on the type of business and the level of application completion, the timeframe for establishing a business in Tecom Freezone may change. Nonetheless, it usually takes two to four weeks to complete the process.
What are the benefits of setting up a business in Tecom Freezone?
100% foreign ownership, tax exemption, faster company registration, access to cutting-edge infrastructure and facilities, and quick visa processing for staff are just a few advantages of establishing a firm in Tecom Freezone.
What are the costs associated with setting up a business in Tecom Freezone?
What types of businesses can be set up in Tecom Freezone?
Tecom Freezone caters to a wide range of business sectors, including media, information technology, education, healthcare, and more.
Do I need to have a physical office in Tecom Freezone to set up a business?
Absolutely, having a physical office or workspace inside the free zone is one of the conditions for establishing a firm in Tecom Freezone.
What is the process for setting up a business in Tecom Freezone?
A business must submit a business plan, choose a legal entity, apply for a trade license, and register with the Dubai Chamber of Business and Industry in order to establish a company in Tecom Freezone.
Can I operate my business outside of Tecom Freezone if I set it up there?
Yes, businesses set up in Tecom Freezone are allowed to operate outside of the free zone, as long as they comply with the regulations and requirements of the Dubai authorities.
What are the requirements for setting up a business in Tecom Freezone?
Depending on the type of business, different requirements may apply for establishing one in Tecom Freezone, although most frequently a valid passport, proof of address, financial records, and other pertinent documents are needed.
Is it mandatory to have a local sponsor to set up a business in Tecom Freezone?
No, one advantage of establishing a firm in Tecom Freezone is that there is no requirement for a local sponsor and 100% international ownership is permitted.

Do you have more questions?

Is Dubai beneficial for Business purposes?
There is no major taxation in Dubai and due to which Dubai is a great place if you want to start your business setup in Dubai.
Best Business for me to start in dubai?
The best business in Dubai that is 100% going to benefit you in every way is the Real Estate business. This business is great to start because it is one of the industries that is mostly established in Dubai. After the real estate, you can start Financial service business, as UAE has an advanced financial system in place.
I am an Indian. Can I start a business in Dubai, UAE?
Yes of course you can start a business in Dubai, not only Indian but everyone from other countries who wants to start business in Dubai are welcome to start their business. In Dubai with the low import duty, free trade, and no taxation you can set up a business that is going to attract people towards your business.
Can I start an online business in Dubai, UAE?

What is an LLC company in the UAE?

How can I get residency in Dubai?

Can a foreigner own a business in Dubai,UAE?

What is an e-Commerce license Dubai?
The e-Commerce license in UAE is a document that allows businesses to establish online operations in the UAE. With it, holders can legally trade goods and services without issues.
What are the types of e-Commerce permits in the UAE?
E-Trader License: This permit will allow holders to provide online services as well as sell products. • Portal License: With this license, entrepreneurs can have a website that allows them to show all the services and goods they provide. • Virtual Company License: With this permit, online businesses can overtake commercial activities in the region.
What is the criteria for the E-Commerce License Dubai?
People and home-based businesses who do online product sales. • If they offer handmade goods, jewelry, fashionable clothing, and other items, housewives and mothers can also apply for a trading license. • Who are reluctant to rent a physical premise but want to conduct business in Dubai. • Online freelancers who provide services. • Firms run from home that do not require or want a regional partner.
What is the E-Commerce License Dubai Cost?
The cost for this particular license in UAE varies according to the type of business and activities they perform in the area.
Which local free zones provide this e-Commerce license?

• DMMC. • DWTC. • Dubai South. • Fujairah Creative City. • RAKEZ. • SHAMS. • SRTIP.

Is it necessary to have office space in Dubai for the e-Commerce license?
No, it is not necessary. However, it is a requirement in some free zones.
Do e-Commerce businesses pay VAT?
If the total amount of its taxable imports and supplies exceeds AED 375,000 annually, an e-commerce company has to register for VAT. Businesses are free from needing to file for VAT if they purchase and supply in excess of AED 187,500 yearly.
Can I operate 2 business under a single e-Commerce License in Dubai?
Yes! if the actions are associated with e-commerce. It is not allowed to conduct independent business operations. You cannot, for instance, use the same license to engage in commerce and subsequently offer professional services.
Are there penalties if I start an online business without the license?

Those who engage in unlawful trade may be subject to fines of as high as AED 50,000 every transaction.

How long do the authorities last to provide the e-Commerce license?
About a week or so, if the paperwork is correct.

Can family members be included in the Golden Visa application?

    No, one advantage of establishing a firm in Tecom Freezone is that there is no requirement for a local sponsor and 100% international ownership is permitted.

Know more about the frequently asked questions

What is IFZA Freezone?
IFZA (International Free Zone Authority) is a free zone and It offers a range of business services and benefits to companies looking to establish their presence in the region.
Can I have a physical office space in IFZA Freezone?
Yes, IFZA Freezone provides office spaces and facilities to meet the needs of different businesses. You can lease office spaces, flexi-desks, or even set up a virtual office, depending on your requirements.
What are the advantages of setting up a business in IFZA Freezone?
Setting up a business in IFZA Freezone provides several advantages, including 100% foreign ownership, no corporate and personal income taxes, no customs duties on goods and services, quick company formation process, flexible office spaces, and a strategic location.
What are the steps to set up a company in IFZA Freezone?
The process of setting up a company in IFZA Freezone involves submitting the required documents, obtaining approvals, selecting a license type, leasing an office space, and completing the registration process. It is recommended to consult with IFZA authorities or a professional service provider for detailed guidance.
What types of licenses are available in IFZA Freezone?
IFZA Freezone offers various types of licenses to cater to different business activities, such as trading, service, consulting, e-commerce, and more. The specific license you need will depend on your business activities.
What are the visa options for employees in IFZA Freezone?
IFZA Freezone offers visa sponsorship for employees working within the free zone. The number of visas available will depend on the size and type of your company. Visa requirements and procedures may vary.
Are there any restrictions on the types of businesses that can operate in IFZA Freezone?
IFZA Freezone accommodates various types of businesses, including trading, consulting, services, and more. However, certain activities may require additional approvals or fulfill specific criteria. It is advisable to check the list of permitted activities and consult with IFZA authorities or a professional service provider.
What are the visa options for employees in JAFZA Freezone?

JAFZA provides visa sponsorship for employees working within the free zone. The number of visas available will depend on the size and type of your company. Visa requirements and procedures may vary, so it is advisable to consult with the JAFZA authorities or a professional service provider.

What is an industrial trade license?

An industrial trade license is a legal document that allows a company to engage in manufacturing, production, or industrial activities within a specific jurisdiction.

What is the duration of an industrial trade license?

The duration of an industrial trade license varies depending on the jurisdiction. It can range from one to several years, and it needs to be renewed upon expiration to continue conducting industrial activities legally.

How do I obtain an industrial trade license?

To obtain an industrial trade license, you typically need to comply with the requirements set by the relevant government authority. This may include providing necessary documentation, meeting specific criteria related to the industrial activities, and paying the required fees.

Can I operate multiple industrial activities under a single license?

Can a foreign individual or company obtain an industrial trade license?

Can I transfer or sell my industrial trade license?

The transfer or sale of an industrial trade license may be allowed in some jurisdictions, subject to the specific procedures and approvals required by the relevant government authority.

Are there any specific regulations or permits required for certain industrial activities?
Yes, depending on the nature of the industrial activities, there may be additional regulations, permits, or certifications required. These can include environmental permits, health and safety compliance, or specialized licenses for specific industries.
What are the consequences of operating without a valid industrial trade license?
Operating without a valid industrial trade license is generally illegal and can result in penalties, fines, legal actions, or the closure of your industrial operations. It is crucial to obtain the necessary license and comply with the regulatory requirements to operate legally.

Can I have a physical office space in JAFZA Freezone?

What types of licenses are available in JAFZA Freezone?
JAFZA offers various licenses to cater to different business activities, including trading, service, industrial, e-commerce, and more. The specific type of license you need will depend on your business activities.

Can I operate my business outside of Tecom Freezone if I set it up there?
Yes, businesses set up in Tecom Freezone are allowed to operate outside of the free zone, as long as they comply with the regulations and requirements of the Dubai authorities.
