Know more about the frequently asked questions

How can I start a business in dubai?

There are few steps that you need to do before starting a business setup in Dubai. You are going to need a license Application, Attested LLC agreement, Governmental forms, name of your business reservation certificate, Initial approval certificate, Government authorities approval, lease contract, Ejari with certificate approval.

Is Dubai beneficial for Business purposes?
There is no major taxation in Dubai and due to which Dubai is a great place if you want to start your business setup in Dubai.
Best Business for me to start in dubai?
The best business in Dubai that is 100% going to benefit you in every way is the Real Estate business. This business is great to start because it is one of the industries that is mostly established in Dubai. After the real estate, you can start Financial service business, as UAE has an advanced financial system in place.
I am an Indian. Can I start a business in Dubai, UAE?
Yes of course you can start a business in Dubai, not only Indian but everyone from other countries who wants to start business in Dubai are welcome to start their business. In Dubai with the low import duty, free trade, and no taxation you can set up a business that is going to attract people towards your business.
Can I start an online business in Dubai, UAE?
Yes, you can start the online business in Dubai, UAE but first you need to know about the legal framework for your business, after that you need to pick a place where you can register the business after this you need to request the license, initial approval certificate, after you have done this you need to draft the Memorandum of association (MOA) and local service agent agreement, the next step towards your online business in Dubai is register a physical office in Dubai, after you have register you need to sign in the physical office in Dubai, UAE and you are done you have successfully started your online business.
What is an LLC company in the UAE?
LLC full form is Limited liability company and this is the common form of business that is followed by everyone here in Dubai, UAE. LLC companies can be created by a minimum of 2 shareholders and a maximum of 50 shareholders whose liability is limited to their corporate capital stock.
How can I get residency in Dubai?
You can get residency in Dubai by finding the sponsor who can sponsor you. You can also get residency by owning a property here in dubai as this is going to help you get the citizenship of Dubai. After this you can also open a bank account in Dubai and you will also find some international bank in Dubai in which you can open an account.
Can a foreigner own a business in Dubai,UAE?
Yes, foreigners can own business in Dubai and the better place to own business in Dubai is in freezone Dubai as it is going to allow the business to own 100 percent of the firm. LLC partnership in Dubai will allow you to own 49% of the business and the rest will be owned by the UAE nationalities.
How much is a business license going to cost in Dubai?
Dubai license cost is going to differ from zone to zone and type of business you want to set up in Dubai. Still the rough figure is that it will be lowest to the highest.

Do you have more questions?

PRO services are not limited to new businesses. Established businesses may also need PRO services for various purposes, including license renewals, visa renewals, amendment of company details, and ongoing compliance with government regulations.

Why is Product Registration is Mandatory in UAE?

The UAE provides investors with a top opportunity to import, export, produce, and distribute different products. This is possible thanks to the product registration process. As a matter of fact, the product registration in Dubai Municipality is compulsory due to the following reasons:

FAQ's

You have a Query about PRO Service in Dubai
We are here to Guide

What are PRO services?

PRO services, also known as Public Relations Officer services, are professional services that assist businesses in handling government-related procedures, document processing, visa processing, and other administrative tasks.

Can PRO services help with document translation and notarization?

Yes, many PRO service providers offer document translation and notarization services as part of their offerings. These services can be useful when dealing with government authorities or submitting documents in a different language.

Why do businesses need PRO services?

Businesses often require PRO services to navigate the complex regulatory landscape, save time and effort in dealing with government authorities, ensure compliance with legal requirements, and streamline administrative processes.

How do PRO services expedite government-related processes?

PRO service providers have extensive knowledge and experience in dealing with government authorities and their procedures. They understand the requirements, documentation, and submission processes, which helps expedite the completion of tasks and reduces the chances of errors or delays.

What types of services do PRO service providers offer?

PRO service providers offer a range of services, including but not limited to: Document attestation and legalization. Visa and immigration services. Trade license registration and renewal. Labor contract and employment-related services. Ministry approvals and permits. Freezone and offshore company setup. Business visa sponsorship. Government entity approvals and clearances.

Are PRO services cost-effective for businesses?
PRO services can be cost-effective for businesses, especially when considering the time, effort, and resources required to handle government-related tasks internally. Outsourcing these tasks to PRO service providers can free up valuable resources and allow businesses to focus on their core operations.
How can PRO services help in business setup?

PRO services can assist in various aspects of business setup, such as obtaining necessary licenses and permits, registering with government authorities, handling visa and immigration processes, and ensuring compliance with labor and employment regulations.

Can PRO services assist with visa-related matters?
Yes, PRO services often specialize in visa and immigration-related services. They can help with visa applications, renewal, cancellation, and sponsorship, ensuring compliance with immigration regulations and making the process smoother and more efficient.
Are PRO services only required for new businesses?

PRO services are not limited to new businesses. Established businesses may also need PRO services for various purposes, including license renewals, visa renewals, amendment of company details, and ongoing compliance with government regulations.

Benefits of Business Professional License in Dubai, UAE

A Professional License in Dubai is a permit that authorizes individuals to carry out professional activities in the emirate. Some of the benefits of Professional License in Dubai include:

  • Professional License is relatively low compared to other types of licenses, such as a commercial or industrial license.
  • Professional License does not require a physical office space to be established, making it a cost-effective option.
  • Foreign nationals can own 100% of the business under a Professional License, without the need for a local sponsor.
  • Professional Licenses can be obtained for a wide range of professional activities
  • Dubai offers several tax benefits for individuals with a Professional License
  • Professional License provides individuals with the flexibility to work independently
Contact Us

Process of obtaining a Professional License in Dubai In Four Steps

Choose the type of activity

The first step is to choose the type of professional activity you want to conduct in Dubai. Activities like as legal, accounting, engineering, and other services.

Apply for the license

Once you have selected the type of activity, you can apply for the Professional License through the Dubai Department of Economic Development (DED).

Obtain necessary approvals

After submitting the application, you may need to obtain certain approvals or clearances from other government departments or authorities.

Receive the license

Once all the necessary approvals are obtained, you will receive your Professional License. This license will allow you to legally conduct your activity in Dubai.

Contact Us

Professional license

Required Document For Professional license

Documents required to obtain a professional license in Dubai may vary depending on the type of business activity, business structure, and the licensing authority:

  • Passport Copies.
  • Residency / Visit visa.
  • No-Objection Certificate(NOC) if employed.
  • Educational certificates.
  • Tenancy contract.
  • Initial approval certificate.
  • Depending on the specific activity, additional approvals may required.

FAQ's

You have a Query about PRO Service in Dubai
We are here to Guide

What is a professional license?
A professional license is a legal document that authorizes an individual to practice a specific profession or offer professional services in a particular jurisdiction.
Are there ongoing requirements or obligations after obtaining a professional license?

Yes, maintaining a professional license often involves fulfilling ongoing requirements, such as continuing education credits, renewing the license periodically, and complying with any ethical or professional conduct standards set by the licensing authority.

What professions typically require a professional license?

Professions that often require a professional license include doctors, lawyers, engineers, architects, accountants, consultants, therapists, and other specialized professionals. The specific professions that require a license may vary depending on the jurisdiction.

Can a professional license be transferred or used in different jurisdictions?
The transferability of a professional license or its recognition in different jurisdictions depends on the specific regulations and agreements between licensing authorities. In some cases, a process known as license reciprocity or license endorsement may allow professionals to practice in a new jurisdiction without having to complete all the requirements from scratch.
How do I obtain a professional license?
To obtain a professional license, you typically need to meet the educational and experience requirements set by the licensing authority. This may involve completing specific educational programs, passing professional exams, and fulfilling any necessary practical training or apprenticeship requirements.
What happens if I practice without a valid professional license?

Practicing without a valid professional license is generally illegal and can result in penalties, fines, legal actions, or the restriction of your ability to practice your profession. It is important to obtain the necessary license and comply with the licensing requirements to practice legally and ethically.

What are the benefits of having a professional license?

Having a professional license provides credibility and legal recognition to your expertise and qualifications in your chosen profession. It allows you to practice your profession legally and provides assurance to clients or employers that you meet the necessary standards of competency and ethics.

How long does it take to obtain a professional license?

The time required to obtain a professional license can vary depending on the jurisdiction and the specific requirements. It can range from a few weeks to several months, considering the time needed for application processing, evaluation of qualifications, and any necessary examinations or assessments.

Can a foreign individual obtain a professional license?

In many cases, foreign individuals can obtain a professional license in a different jurisdiction. However, there may be specific requirements or additional steps to fulfill, such as obtaining equivalency certifications for educational qualifications or passing local licensing exams.

Can I upgrade or expand my professional license to offer additional services?

In some cases, professionals may have the option to upgrade or expand their professional license to include additional services or specialties. This typically involves meeting additional requirements, such as completing further education or training in the desired area of specialization.

How can I start a business in dubai?

There are few steps that you need to do before starting a business setup in Dubai. You are going to need a license Application, Attested LLC agreement, Governmental forms, name of your business reservation certificate, Initial approval certificate, Government authorities approval, lease contract, Ejari with certificate approval.

Is Dubai beneficial for Business purposes?
There is no major taxation in Dubai and due to which Dubai is a great place if you want to start your business setup in Dubai.
Best Business for me to start in dubai?
The best business in Dubai that is 100% going to benefit you in every way is the Real Estate business. This business is great to start because it is one of the industries that is mostly established in Dubai. After the real estate, you can start Financial service business, as UAE has an advanced financial system in place.
I am an Indian. Can I start a business in Dubai, UAE?
Yes of course you can start a business in Dubai, not only Indian but everyone from other countries who wants to start business in Dubai are welcome to start their business. In Dubai with the low import duty, free trade, and no taxation you can set up a business that is going to attract people towards your business.
Can I start an online business in Dubai, UAE?
Yes, you can start the online business in Dubai, UAE but first you need to know about the legal framework for your business, after that you need to pick a place where you can register the business after this you need to request the license, initial approval certificate, after you have done this you need to draft the Memorandum of association (MOA) and local service agent agreement, the next step towards your online business in Dubai is register a physical office in Dubai, after you have register you need to sign in the physical office in Dubai, UAE and you are done you have successfully started your online business.
What is an LLC company in the UAE?
LLC full form is Limited liability company and this is the common form of business that is followed by everyone here in Dubai, UAE. LLC companies can be created by a minimum of 2 shareholders and a maximum of 50 shareholders whose liability is limited to their corporate capital stock.
How can I get residency in Dubai?
You can get residency in Dubai by finding the sponsor who can sponsor you. You can also get residency by owning a property here in dubai as this is going to help you get the citizenship of Dubai. After this you can also open a bank account in Dubai and you will also find some international bank in Dubai in which you can open an account.
Can a foreigner own a business in Dubai,UAE?
Yes, foreigners can own business in Dubai and the better place to own business in Dubai is in freezone Dubai as it is going to allow the business to own 100 percent of the firm. LLC partnership in Dubai will allow you to own 49% of the business and the rest will be owned by the UAE nationalities.
How much is a business license going to cost in Dubai?
Dubai license cost is going to differ from zone to zone and type of business you want to set up in Dubai. Still the rough figure is that it will be lowest to the highest.

The retirement visa program in Dubai offers a range of benefits to retirees who want to enjoy their golden years in the UAE. Some of the benefits are:

  • Retirees can own property in Dubai, providing a secure investment and a comfortable living space.

Age

The applicant must be at least 55 years old at the time of application.

Financial Requirements

Evidence of financial stability, monthly income of AED 20,000 or savings of at least AED 1 million.

Read More

Health Insurance

The applicant must have valid health insurance coverage in the UAE.

Read More

Property Ownership

Own a property in Dubai worth at least AED 2 million or have savings of at least AED 1 million.

Read More
Contact Us

Retirement Visa Dubai, UAE

Required Document For Retirement Visa

To apply for a Retirement Visa in Dubai, the following documents are typically required:

  • Passport Copy of the applicant.
  • Spouse’s passport copy and marriage certificate(if applicable).
  • UAE visa copy (for residents)/ Visit visa.
  • Emirates ID copy(for resident).
  • Proof of income/6-month bank statement.

FAQ's

Know more about the frequently asked questions

What is a Retirement Visa in the UAE?
The Retirement Visa in the UAE is a visa category designed for individuals who have reached retirement age and wish to retire in the UAE.
How long is a Retirement Visa valid in the UAE?
The validity of a Retirement Visa in the UAE may vary, but it is typically granted for a period of one to five years, subject to renewal.
What are the eligibility criteria for a Retirement Visa in the UAE?
To be eligible for a Retirement Visa in the UAE, applicants must meet certain criteria, including age requirements, minimum income or financial resources, and health insurance coverage.
What is the minimum age requirement for a Retirement Visa in the UAE?
The minimum age requirement for a Retirement Visa in the UAE is typically 55 years or older.
Can I own property or invest in the UAE with a Retirement Visa?
The ability to own property or invest in the UAE with a Retirement Visa may depend on additional factors and regulations.
How much income or financial resources are required for a Retirement Visa in the UAE?
The specific income or financial resources required for a Retirement Visa in the UAE may vary, and it is advisable to check the latest requirements set by the UAE authorities.
Can I work with a Retirement Visa in the UAE?
A Retirement Visa in the UAE is not intended for employment purposes. It is designed to allow retirees to reside and enjoy their retirement in the UAE.

Benefits of Sharjah Airport International Freezone

A variety of advantages and incentives are available for businesses in the Sharjah Airport International Freezone (SAIF Zone), a special economic zone in the emirate of Sharjah, United Arab Emirates. Among the advantages of establishing a business in the SAIF Zone are:

  • Foreign investors can have 100% ownership of their business.
  • Full repatriation of capital and profits
  • 0% corporate and personal income tax
  • Total exemption from custom duties
  • Full free transfer of funds
  • Competitive rates for company registration and licensing
  • Access to highly developed sea ports of Khor Fakkan Port and Khalid Port
  • Access to the Sharjah International Airport
  • Safe business environment
  • Access to international markets

Commercial license

Connect ME will help you obtain commercial trading license for your business setup in SAIF Zone

Service License

Sharjah Airport International Freezone (SAIF Zone)

Required Documents for Sharjah Airport International Freezone (SAIF Zone)

Depending on the type of license and the type of business, different documentation may be needed to open a business in the SAIF Zone at Sharjah Airport. Nonetheless, the following are some of the typical paperwork needed for company establishment in the SAIF Zone:

  • Copy of each shareholder’s passport
  • Passport size photo in color with white background
  • Business plan.
  • Company Application Form (for Initial Approval and Registration).
  • Project summary
  • Certificate of Incorporation and bank statement (for branch company)
  • Trade name (minimum 5 trade name)
  • Minimum capital deposit

FAQ's

Know more about the frequently asked questions

How can I start a business in dubai?

There are few steps that you need to do before starting a business setup in Dubai. You are going to need a license Application, Attested LLC agreement, Governmental forms, name of your business reservation certificate, Initial approval certificate, Government authorities approval, lease contract, Ejari with certificate approval.

Is Dubai beneficial for Business purposes?
There is no major taxation in Dubai and due to which Dubai is a great place if you want to start your business setup in Dubai.
Best Business for me to start in dubai?
The best business in Dubai that is 100% going to benefit you in every way is the Real Estate business. This business is great to start because it is one of the industries that is mostly established in Dubai. After the real estate, you can start Financial service business, as UAE has an advanced financial system in place.
I am an Indian. Can I start a business in Dubai, UAE?
Yes of course you can start a business in Dubai, not only Indian but everyone from other countries who wants to start business in Dubai are welcome to start their business. In Dubai with the low import duty, free trade, and no taxation you can set up a business that is going to attract people towards your business.
Can I start an online business in Dubai, UAE?
Yes, you can start the online business in Dubai, UAE but first you need to know about the legal framework for your business, after that you need to pick a place where you can register the business after this you need to request the license, initial approval certificate, after you have done this you need to draft the Memorandum of association (MOA) and local service agent agreement, the next step towards your online business in Dubai is register a physical office in Dubai, after you have register you need to sign in the physical office in Dubai, UAE and you are done you have successfully started your online business.
What is an LLC company in the UAE?
LLC full form is Limited liability company and this is the common form of business that is followed by everyone here in Dubai, UAE. LLC companies can be created by a minimum of 2 shareholders and a maximum of 50 shareholders whose liability is limited to their corporate capital stock.
How can I get residency in Dubai?
You can get residency in Dubai by finding the sponsor who can sponsor you. You can also get residency by owning a property here in dubai as this is going to help you get the citizenship of Dubai. After this you can also open a bank account in Dubai and you will also find some international bank in Dubai in which you can open an account.
Can a foreigner own a business in Dubai,UAE?
Yes, foreigners can own business in Dubai and the better place to own business in Dubai is in freezone Dubai as it is going to allow the business to own 100 percent of the firm. LLC partnership in Dubai will allow you to own 49% of the business and the rest will be owned by the UAE nationalities.
How much is a business license going to cost in Dubai?
Dubai license cost is going to differ from zone to zone and type of business you want to set up in Dubai. Still the rough figure is that it will be lowest to the highest.

Do you have more questions?

FAQ's

Know more about the frequently asked questions

What is Tecom Freezone?
In Dubai, United Arab Emirates, there is a business hub called Tecom Freezone. It is one of Dubai’s biggest and most thriving free zones, providing entrepreneurs and enterprises with a variety of business-friendly rules, incentives, and infrastructure.
How long does it take to set up a business in Tecom Freezone?
Depending on the type of business and the level of application completion, the timeframe for establishing a business in Tecom Freezone may change. Nonetheless, it usually takes two to four weeks to complete the process.
What are the benefits of setting up a business in Tecom Freezone?
100% foreign ownership, tax exemption, faster company registration, access to cutting-edge infrastructure and facilities, and quick visa processing for staff are just a few advantages of establishing a firm in Tecom Freezone.
What are the costs associated with setting up a business in Tecom Freezone?
What types of businesses can be set up in Tecom Freezone?
Tecom Freezone caters to a wide range of business sectors, including media, information technology, education, healthcare, and more.
Do I need to have a physical office in Tecom Freezone to set up a business?
Absolutely, having a physical office or workspace inside the free zone is one of the conditions for establishing a firm in Tecom Freezone.
What is the process for setting up a business in Tecom Freezone?
A business must submit a business plan, choose a legal entity, apply for a trade license, and register with the Dubai Chamber of Business and Industry in order to establish a company in Tecom Freezone.
Can I operate my business outside of Tecom Freezone if I set it up there?
Yes, businesses set up in Tecom Freezone are allowed to operate outside of the free zone, as long as they comply with the regulations and requirements of the Dubai authorities.
What are the requirements for setting up a business in Tecom Freezone?
Depending on the type of business, different requirements may apply for establishing one in Tecom Freezone, although most frequently a valid passport, proof of address, financial records, and other pertinent documents are needed.
Is it mandatory to have a local sponsor to set up a business in Tecom Freezone?
No, one advantage of establishing a firm in Tecom Freezone is that there is no requirement for a local sponsor and 100% international ownership is permitted.

You have a Query about PRO Service in Dubai
We are here to Guide

What is a tourism license?

A tourism license is a legal document that permits individuals or businesses to operate in the tourism industry, offering services such as accommodations, travel agencies, tour operators, or other tourism-related activities.

Are there any specific qualifications or training required for a tourism license?

The qualifications or training requirements for a tourism license vary depending on the type of tourism activity and the jurisdiction. Some businesses or positions may require specific certifications, qualifications, or training in areas such as hospitality management, tour guiding, first aid, or other relevant fields.

Why do I need a tourism license?

A tourism license is required to legally operate in the tourism industry and offer services to tourists. It ensures compliance with regulations, establishes credibility, and provides consumer protection.

Is it necessary to renew a tourism license?

Yes, a tourism license typically needs to be renewed periodically, as specified by the tourism authorities. Renewal requirements may include submitting updated documents, paying renewal fees, and demonstrating compliance with ongoing regulations and standards.

What types of businesses require a tourism license?

Businesses such as hotels, resorts, guesthouses, travel agencies, tour operators, adventure companies, transportation services, and other entities involved in providing tourism services typically require a tourism license.

What are the benefits of having a tourism license?

Having a tourism license provides credibility and legitimacy to your tourism business, instills confidence in customers and partners, and allows you to operate legally within the tourism industry. It also enables you to access certain privileges, promotions, or collaborations offered exclusively to licensed tourism operators.

How do I obtain a tourism license?

The process to obtain a tourism license varies depending on the jurisdiction. Generally, you will need to meet specific criteria set by the tourism authorities, which may include having proper infrastructure, qualified staff, financial stability, and adherence to health and safety regulations. It often involves submitting an application, providing supporting documents, and undergoing inspections or assessments.

Can I operate without a tourism license?

Operating without a required tourism license is generally illegal and can result in penalties, fines, or closure of your business. It is important to comply with the regulations and obtain the necessary license to ensure legal operation and consumer trust.

Can an individual also obtain a tourism license?

In some cases, individuals can obtain a tourism license for activities such as tour guiding or offering specific tourism-related services. However, the requirements and regulations may differ for individual licenses compared to licenses for businesses.

Can I expand or diversify my services under an existing tourism license?

Expanding or diversifying your services under an existing tourism license may be possible, depending on the specific regulations and requirements of the jurisdiction. You may need to update your license or obtain additional permissions or certifications for the new services you plan to offer.
